chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about the Words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'And give its due on the day of its harvest, and do not be extravagant.'
He (peace be upon him) said: 'My father (peace be upon him) used to say: Among the extravagance in harvesting and reaping is that a man gives in charity with both his palms together.'

And my father, whenever something of this was presented to him, and he saw one of his servants giving charity with both his hands, would shout at him, 'Give with one hand, the handful after the handful, the bale after the bale, from the ears of corn.'

key_terms.الضِّغْثُ: A bundle or bale of grain

ai.seo_question: What constitutes extravagance in giving harvest charity according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi elucidates the practical application of Quranic verse 6:141 by defining 'israf' (extravagance) in harvesting not as waste, but as hasty, bulk charity that bypasses careful stewardship. Imam al-Sadiq (AS) instructs his followers to distribute harvest gradually, one handful at a time, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on moderation (wasatiyyah) and mindful management of blessings. This method ensures that charity is distributed with intention and prevents the impulsive depletion of resources.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Abu Nasr, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassanasws, said, ‘I asked himasws about the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [6:141] and give the due of it on the day of its harvest and do not act extravagantly.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘My<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘From the extravagance during the harvest and replanting is that the man gives in charity with both his palms’, and it was so that whenever my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> was presented something from this, and he<sup>asws</sup> saw one of his slaves giving charity with both his hands, would shout at him, ‘Give with one hand, the handful after the handful, the bale after the bale!’, from the ears of corn’.
en.sarwar: 6. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr who has said the following:
“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the words of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, ‘. . . give His right on the day of harvest and do not be wasteful ... 5 [6:141].
He (the Imam) said, ‘My father would say that wastefulness in harvest and picking up fruits is giving the beggars with both hands.

When people asking for help would come and if my father had seen the slaves give them charity with both hands, he called them and told them to give with one hand a handful after handful and a bunch after bunch of the ears of wheat.’”
